import pathlib
path=pathlib.Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485747/attempts/18dbe85446804b4a9d8265837008f502/system/state/workspace/programs/task-13eaba59.py')
text='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # The marked cell is the origin; color the framed interior in alternating
    # square-distance bands, preserving the mark and the frame.
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==3 and 0<r<len(grid)-1 and 0<c<len(row)-1 and grid[r][c-1]==0 and grid[r][c+1]==0]
    # select the interior mark rather than frame cells
    mark=next(((r,c) for r,c in pts if grid[r-1][c]==0 and grid[r+1][c]==0),None)
    if mark is None: return out
    mr,mc=mark
    for r in range(3,10):
        for c in range(4,11):
            if (r,c)==mark: continue
            d=max(abs(r-mr),abs(c-mc))
            out[r][c]=4 if d%2==0 else 2
    return out
'''
path.write_text(text)
exec(text)

for r in range(2,11):grid[r][3]=grid[r][11]=3

ans=transform(grid)
